title: Action Comics #988 DC 2017 Lenticular 3D Cover Oz Effect Part 2 Superman Rebirth
condition_description: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Action Comics #988 (DC Comics, November 2017), Lenticular Edition. DC Universe Rebirth, "The Oz Effect" part 2. Motion lenticular cover by Robson Rocha: Jor-El and Lara with baby Kal-El's rocket, changing as you tilt it (second photo shows the other image). Written by Dan Jurgens. Direct Sales edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Batman: Mask of the Phantasm Blu-ray ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
